title: Egyptian Beef Kebabs
description: A simple and flavorful recipe for beef kebabs with an Egyptian twist, served with toasted pita bread.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together kissed oil, egyptian, salt, and pepper.
Add the beef fillet to the bowl and mix well to coat.
Thread the beef onto the kebabs, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 5-7 minutes on each side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Brush the kebabs with lemon juice during the last minute of grilling.
Serve the kebabs hot with toasted pita bread and your favorite sides.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Slice the kebabs against the grain and serve.
